title: Base change of a trace evaluation
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $L,K$ objects of the ordinary unbounded derived category of $A$-module etale sheaves on $Y$. Use the canonical constructions of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data]. Let $t:Rf_*(f^*L)\to A_Y$ and $t_2:Rp_{2*}(p_2^*f^*L)\to A_X$ satisfy $\mathrm{exchange2}(f^*L)$ followed by $Rp_{2*}\mathrm{coordinate}(L)$ and $t_2$ equals $f^*t$ followed by the pullback unit comparison. Then inverse $\mathrm{exchange2}(HK)$ followed by $f^*\mathrm{evaluation}(K)$ equals the composite of $Rp_{2*}\mathrm{coordinateH}(L,K)$, $Rp_{2*}$ of the $p_2$ tensor comparison on $f^*K,f^*L$, inverse ordered projection for $p_2$ with coefficient $f^*K$ and kernel $p_2^*f^*L$, identity tensor $t_2$, and the right unitor. No hypothesis on the self symmetry of $L$ is imposed.

proof.text: Specialize etaleTensorEvaluation_constant_baseChange to the self pullback, kernel f*L and its coordinate comparison. Use orderedProjection_eq_symmetry to identify its two flipped-tensor projection maps with the specified orderedProjectionIso homs. The scalar hypothesis is ht reversed. The source theorem leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_rightUnitor_hom supplies its unit law for leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso.

proof.text: The inverse comparison for the ordinary self-pullback square equals the hom comparison for the reversed square: both are the two inverse-image compositors through the same morphism, and equality of that morphism plus proof irrelevance identifies them. The resulting equality is exactly coordinateH followed by the p2 tensor comparison.

theorem traceBaseChangeEvaluation [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (t : (push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L) ⟶ constantComplex A Y)
    (t2 : (push A (pullback.snd f f)).obj
        ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ⟶ constantComplex A X)
    (ht : (exchange2 A f ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫
        (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map (coordinate A f L).hom ≫ t2 =
      (pull A f).map t ≫ (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (exchange2 A f ((H A f L).obj K)).inv ≫
        (pull A f).map (evaluation A f L t K) =
      (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map (coordinateH A f L K).hom ≫
        (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map
          (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)
            ((pull A f).obj K) ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫
        (orderedProjectionIso A (pullback.snd f f) ((pull A f).obj K)
          ((pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj ((pull A f).obj L))).inv ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj ((pull A f).obj K)).map t2 ≫
        (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X ((pull A f).obj K)).hom
